lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, approximately circular pixel clusters are arranged in a regular grid-like configuration posterior to the fifth gill slit, extending across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal bands of similar intensity to form a lattice, with the high-luminance blobs predominantly located at these intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal lineaments on the upper flank show a sharp vertical luminance gradient (light superior edge, shadowed inferior edge), indicating longitudinal carinae.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains approximately 10-12 discrete high-luminance blobs of varying diameters, distributed primarily across the basal and central regions of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch is visible on the posterior margin of the first dorsal fin; multiple dark, elongated remoras are attached to the distal section of the left pectoral fin; small reddish pixel clusters are visible in the inter-branchial regions.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, circular high-luminance spots that decrease in diameter and density toward the posterior and distal margins.
